name: Ingrid Lindgren
action: Ingrid glances briefly at her phone, then looks back at him and says, “Yes—coffee after the final session would work, provided I can confirm my mother’s nurse first. I’m free for a short conversation, but I do need to keep my evening tight.”
reason: Ingrid sees the invitation as useful and recognizes that his questions were thoughtful, but she also feels constrained by the need to confirm her mother’s nurse’s arrival and avoid letting the evening sprawl. That conflict leads her to accept only on the condition that it stays limited to coffee after the final session and that her evening remain tight.
